translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Bzkq Nzamrluengr Kxnzetung Myaszpxle Leplz Txneng
Mzlengeng x inwengeng, bzkq amrlueamu kzdung leplz nzmyaszpx-krde kzdung kz leplz. Murde mz nzlxngiti-krmu Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, nakrlz-kzamu kx nide txpwz kxmyapxbz mz leplz.
Mwx kzdq mzli kzdq bcnyr kx pxi lrpz kxmrlzvxi navzm mz makxtr nyzmu, x mzli lcpwz navz-kzpq kzdq doa kxtr-rngiscu kx pxine lrpz txne.
Bzkq amrlueamu ncblo kc tqpxi lrpz kxmrlz, mz nzrpi-krbzmu bade kx, “Wxbu mrlcde se tqbrngz.” X bzkq obqszoamu doa kxtr-rngiscu, mz nzrpi-krbzmu bade kx, “Wxbunepwz mz nibr leplz kxkqlu.”
Murde mz nzale-krmu da lc, vz-rbramu mz nzobqkr Gct. X akipxamu leplz mz nzamyalz-krmu kxnzetung kx ngi bcnyr murde narkabz bamu da. A' da kx myapxbz nzrvz-nqblqngr nqmq kr Kraes.

Lalztq-angidrmamu, kx mzlengeng x inwengeng. Gct mcpxle kxtrnzrngiscung mz nrlc ka murde nabrti zlwz drtwrdr nide x natwzlr da kcng tqvzpxm bade mz nzngini-krde King rdr x narmctilr nzlungr kxboi Heven. Murde da lcng tqpipxle nakabzle mz leplz kcng tzmrlztilr nide.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, bzkq obqszoamu kxtrnzrngiscung. Murde bcnyrng x kxnzetung nzatrkatilr nimu x nztwzlr nimu mz kot.
X nzrpivxiti-kzng drtq Jiszs, kc tqngi nede nimu.
Nakrlzamu nzalengr da kxtubq mz nzvz-nqblqngr natq kxmyapxbz mz Nzryrngrkxtr, kc tqrpi-ngrde kx, “Namrlztiq kztemqng da kc tqwaiq nzmrlzti-lzbq-krm.”
A' nzmu kx tqmrlzti-txpwzmu kzdung leplz, ngipe alwx. X vz-rbramu mz Lou sc Gct.
Kxmule esz' doa kx rtrngztibzle da amrlx kcng tqyc mz Loukxtr, a' vz-rbrti-alzule kzdq da kxtopwzne, e apu-kzpwzle doa kc tqtao mz lou kcng amrlx, x takitrde nzayrplapxngr nide.

Murde Gct kc tqrpile kx, “Bzkq rmwimiq doa kx trngiu krnalzm,” rpi-kzle kx, “Bzkq rnibqq leplz.” Mz nzmu-krde lcde, ncblo kx tr-rmwimiu doa kx trngiu krnalzde, a' rnibq doa, rnzlvzole nivz kc tqngi nou Loukxtr atwrnrngr.
Gct sa na-ayzlu-ngrbzle bamu mz nzvz-nqblq-krde da amrlx kcng tqpiamu x tqaleamu, mz nzmc-krde kx vz-nqblqamu natqde mz nzmrlzti-krmu leplz o trtingr.
Trpnzngr nzyckr drtwrde doa kx tryc-kz-ngru drtwrde leplz. A' doa kx yc mz drtwrde leplz, namcle nzyckr drtwr Gct nide mzli kc napipx-ngrde neke tubq x neke vz-rbr.
Mane Nzrlxngititx-ngrpwz Gct, A' Trpnzngr Kx Vz-nqblqle Natqde
Mzlengeng x inwengeng, mane nzrpikr doa kx lxngitile Gct, a' trpnzngr da kxmrlz kx vzpxm mz nzrlxngiti-krde. Murde nzrlxngitingr kxmule lc trkrlzleu nzarlapx-krde nide.
Nzmu kzdung kztemqng kx trpnzngr scdr lrpz x trpnzngr nadr dakxnzng,

mane nzrpi-krbzme badr kx, “Krka'-ngrne kx namnc-zpwxamu, nrkrdrtqmu namrlz, x nelzmu nakrlc,” a' mzli lcpwz trpnzngr da kx okatr-ngrn nidr. ?Memule, nzycmnetx-ngrpwz kxmule lc krlzle nzokatr-krde nidr?
Mz nqmq lcpwz, mane nzlxngiti-krm Gct, a' mzli kcpwz trvz-nqblqwq natqde mz nzale-krm da kxmrlz kxnaokatrngr.
Murde doa kx lxngiti-angidrle Jiszs, ale-kzle da kxmrlz kx naokatrngr. A' doa kx rpile kx lxngitile Jiszs, a' trpnzngr da kxmrlz kxalele, rblx nzrmcngr nzrlxngiti-krde.

Nzrlxngiti-angidrngr navzmi nzrvz-nqblqngr natq Gct. Mane nzrpikr doa kx lxngitile kx Gct esz'txu, murde drka' nzlxngiti-kzlr da lc. Dekc tzrnrcti-lzbq-ngrdr mz zmwxlr, murde nzkrlzlr kx Gct sa na-ayrplapxle nidr mz nzrnzlvzo-krdr natqde. Opx angidr kx trngi-txpwzu nzrlxngitingr kxmule lc kx na-arlapxle leplz.
Bzkq angqngutitr-lzbqamu mz nzpxtxpx-krmu nztekqtr-krmu drtwrmu. Murde mane nzrlxngititx-ngrpwz, a' trpnzngr kxvz-nqblqle natq Gct.
Gct rpile kx melrmqgu Ebraam tubq mz nzobq-krde, murde rlrpx-lzbq mz nzvz-nqblq-krde natq Gct, dekc tqrlr-ngrbzle mrlxde Aesak mz olta.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, opx angidr kx nzlxngiti-krde Gct vzmi nzvz-nqblq-krde natqde. Atutrle nzrlxngiti-krde mz da kx alele mz nzvz-nqblq-krde natq Gct.
Krlc drtwr ngr Nzryrngrkxtr kc tqrpile kx, “Ebraam tubq mz nzobqkr Gct, murde brti drtwrde nide.” Dekc tzrpi-ngrdr kx nide kzte Gct.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, opx angidr kx nztubqkr doa mz nzobqkr Gct vzpxm mz da kx alele mz nzvz-nqblq-krde natqde. A' nztubqngr trvzpxpuu mz nzrlxngititx-ngrpwz.

Kxmu-kzle lc mz olvz kc tqngi srlx, drtqde Reab. Murde adwatrle lr Israel kcng nzling ma nyzde. X mz nibrde, sc tqaprpxpeleng mz nzo-zli-krdr lrpzki kzble, murde narlapxng. Dekc tqrpingr Gct kx Reab tubq mz nzobq-krde, mz nzvz-nqblq-krde da kx alele.
Nzrlxngitingr kx trvz-nqblqleu natq Gct apule nrkrdrtq kx trycminiu, murde nzbzng rlilrdr.

footnotes.text: 2:21-23 Gct abrtzlvzle nzrlxngitikr Ebraam. A' nzmu Ebraam trnavz-nqblqleu natqde, drtwr ngrde kx trlxngiti-angidrleu nide. Nzvz-nqblq-krgu natqde vzpxm mz nzrlxngiti-krgu. X nzrlxngiti-angidr-krgu navzmi zvz nzvz-nqblq-krgu natqde. Pol pi-zvzle kx nztubq-krgu vzpxm mz nzlxngiti-krgu Gct. X Jemes aopxmle bagu kx nzrlxngiti-angidr-krgu navzmi kz nzvz-nqblq-krgu natq Gct. Jemes x Pol drtwrdr esz'ti.
